general_requirements: All construction must comply with local building codes and HUD standards. Energy-efficient materials and practices are required.
material_and_thickness: Compacted fill: 12 inches of crushed stone; Base course: 6 inches of compacted gravel
demolition_details: Minimal demolition required. Existing structures to be removed and materials recycled where possible.
storm_drainage_details: Surface drainage to be directed to a retention pond. Underground drains to be installed as per engineering plans.
curbs_and_gutters_details: Concrete curbs and gutters to be installed along all roads and walkways.
pavement_details: Asphalt pavement with a thickness of 4 inches for roads and 3 inches for parking areas.
equipment_for_special_areas: Playground equipment, benches, and lighting fixtures to be installed in community areas.
finish_grading_details: Final grading to ensure proper drainage and level surfaces. Topsoil to be replaced and seeded for landscaping.
lawns_and_planting_details: Native plants and grass species to be used for landscaping. Drip irrigation system to be installed.
additional_notes: Regular inspections to be conducted by the local authority to ensure compliance with all specifications and standards.
